name: homePos
meaning: return position: set to pos by elastic_Init (after SnapToGround) and by msg 9 arg 1; elastic_Reset puts it back there when state < 4 and the object is in the world

name: tensionColourTable
meaning: 30 dwords at stride 8 (0x174 + 8*i, i < 30) set to bandColour every frame by elastic_UpdateTensionColour; the odd dwords are never written. No reader found (the band mesh uses the constant diffuse 0x006B1917).

name: bandMeshKey
meaning: 16 bytes copied from the item model. Its address is the key of the elastic's private Mesh in g_texKeys, and inst.model points here in band mode.

name: itemModel
meaning: the original (coiled item) model, restored by elastic_SetBandMode(0)

name: bandColour
meaning: Rgb24_Lerp(0x10040ff, 0x10000d0, tension); written only

name: tree1
meaning: ElasticTree the first end is tied to (msg 0x17 finds it; msg 0x15 ties). When tree1 is untied while strung, tree2 takes its place.

name: tree2
meaning: second ElasticTree: the nearest tree found by the state-3 msg-2 query; set as the second anchor by msg 1

name: launched
meaning: object being thrown in state 6: the Wolf (state-4 launch) or the nearest candidate found by elastic_LaunchTargetScoreCB (state-5 release). Not cleared in state 7.

name: camRestrict1
meaning: CameraRestriction (IDCAMREST) of tree1, from msg 0x1a80; switched with msg 0xd80

name: camRestrict2
meaning: CameraRestriction of tree2, from msg 0x1a80

name: anchorA
meaning: tree1.pos with 0x50 subtracted from the vertical (80 above the tree base)

name: anchorB
meaning: tree2.pos with 0x50 subtracted from the vertical

name: bandMid
meaning: (A+B)/2: centre of the vibration after a release or launch

name: wolfPrevPos
meaning: Wolf position copied every Update in state 3; msg 0x1a subState 1 adds (Wolf pos - wolfPrevPos) to the step before applying tension

name: bandFrame
meaning: yaw-only frame of the A→B line (heading + 0x800), built by elastic_BuildBandFrame; trans at +0x2c0 is zero. Used by elastic_ProjectOntoBand.

name: perpDist
meaning: |perpendicular distance| of the last projected point from the band line; 0 when outside the span. More than 100 is needed for a launch, less than 100 lets the query return CTX 0x16.

name: engagedSide
meaning: ElasticSide (+0x2c / -0x2c) of the side the Wolf pushed into; 0x4d = none

name: engaged
meaning: 1 while the Wolf has crossed into the strung band and it follows him

name: pullUpTarget
meaning: ElasticTree pullUpPoint (&IDPOINTUP box.min) from msg 0x1a80: where the bungee pull-up takes Ralph

name: pullUpStart
meaning: position at which the pull-up began

name: tension
meaning: 4.12: (len - max/2)/(max/2), clamped at 0 or above (0x1000 = LONGUEUR_MAX). Decays 0x40 per frame in Update.

name: pullUpAngle
meaning: eased pull-up phase, 0..0xa00

name: pullUpRate
meaning: angle per ms << 12, from a pull speed of 614 u/s

name: launchTension
meaning: tension latched at launch or release; scales DISTANCE and HAUTEUR

name: holdMs
meaning: ms held at tension >= 0xe00 while grounded; the launch fires above 999

name: overstretched
meaning: set when the stretch exceeds LONGUEUR_MAX (elastic_ApplyTension)

name: unk2e5
meaning: zeroed by elastic_ResetToItem only; no reader found

name: launchDir
meaning: 4.12 horizontal unit vector (x, 0, z) = -stretch/|stretch|

name: launchTravelled
meaning: horizontal distance covered by the launch

name: launchSpeed
meaning: VITESSE_PROJECTION*1024/1000; the step is launchSpeed*g_dtMs>>10

name: launchAnglePerUnit
meaning: 0x800000/distance, so the sine hump ends at 0x800; wraps for distance <= 256, and distance 0 is an idiv fault at 0x4b627b

name: launchBaseY
meaning: vertical position of the launched object at the start

name: launchHeight
meaning: HAUTEUR_PROJECTION*T>>12, the arc apex

name: vibFrom
meaning: vibration end point 1 (release position)

name: vibTo
meaning: vibration end point 2 = 2*mid - from, with +0xa0 on the vertical

name: vibT
meaning: lerp parameter around 0x800

name: vibRate
meaning: (rate<<12)/1000 truncated to s16 (0x2000 → -31982); sign flips at each end

name: vibAmp
meaning: amplitude, starts at 0x800 and is multiplied by 3/4 at each end; the vibration stops below 1

name: stretch
meaning: state 3: Wolf - A. States 4 and 5: 2*Wolf - (A+B). Input of elastic_ApplyTension and the launch direction.

name: VITESSE_PROJECTION
meaning: designer property: launch speed, units/s

name: DISTANCE_PROJECTION
meaning: designer property: launch distance at full tension

name: HAUTEUR_PROJECTION
meaning: designer property: launch arc height at full tension

name: LONGUEUR_MAX
meaning: designer property: maximum stretch length

name: camera
meaning: IDCAMERA setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos}; the launch of a non-Wolf object is followed from here

name: state
meaning: ElasticState

name: subState
meaning: ElasticSubState (state 3 only)

name: isWolfRider
meaning: registered in the Wolf rider list (msg 0x18) and therefore receives msg 0x1a

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: 1 if this elastic froze the Wolf (msg 0xe) for its launch camera
